band_origin.easy: Authored introductory f-prime/f recognition; sources have no easy labels
band_origin.moderate: Authored intermediate band: affine trig/power denominator plus coefficient adjustment; sources have no moderate labels
band_origin.hard: Source-anchored definite log evaluation, nested substitution, or supported rational rearrangement

pool_policy: Structural family first, then valid parameters. No zero definite answers or old task reuse. Both coefficient signs within each family.
answer_form: Render the canonical answer once, use it verbatim as the worked solution final result; preserve trig arguments and show log quotient conversion.
calibration_limit: Source labels are evidence, not an external psychometric validation of authored bands.
